LUGANO tests non-inferiority against on-label aflibercept at week 56 inside a -4.5-letter margin - EyePoint's own CEO stated the margin publicly. Ocular's matching non-inferiority trial, SOL-R, does not read until 1Q 2027. No sustained-release TKI has cleared a repeat-dosing non-inferiority design anywhere. The evidence base for the specific bar LUGANO must clear is empty. (4) THE FLOOR IS LOWER THAN THE FILE'S OWN CORRECTED NUMBER. Re-solve $12.41 against a comp-anchored $22 win and a verified ~$3.00 failure and the market already implies about 49% - at or above the file's own 45% clean-win read. Raw risk/reward falls from 3.1:1 to roughly 1.1:1. The catalyst is genuinely live and unfired; the asymmetry underwriting the position is not.

EyePoint has had an ATM facility with Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. since August 2020 at a 3.0% commission, disclosed in the Q1 2026 10-Q; it simply was not drawn during the three months ended 31 Mar 2026. The financing gun exists, it is holstered. Separately, 'no debt of note' is loose: $22.3m of finance-lease obligations on the Northbridge facility rank ahead of equity.

RUNWAY (material): 'into the fourth quarter of 2027' on $222.5m requires burn to fall to roughly $32m per quarter against $80.5m actually spent in Q1 2026, on a burn line that has risen every quarter. Funded through the readout verifies; funded to Q4 2027 at the current run-rate does not - so a failure leaves a shell with under two quarters of cash and no negotiating position, exactly the condition in which the soft part of the floor does not clear.

CATALYST / DATE (minor - confirms the file's own correction): the board's 31 July 2026 hard date is an artifact; no company disclosure schedules anything for that day. Company guidance is 'data readouts beginning mid-year' (Q1 release, 6 May 2026); management's last specific framing was 'call it, next July, August, and LUCIA roughly two months behind that' (Cantor, 3 Sep 2025). PENDING_HARD overstates it: the event is sponsor-controlled and soft-dated, though mechanically forced.
